_about: Schedule-slip classes: how often an event of this kind does NOT take place on the day it was scheduled or expected (postponed, interrupted, dropped, moved). The adversarial and base-rate forecasters start the postponement risk from these rates (METHODOLOGY 4.1). Every claim names its class in `slip_class` ('none' when no scheduled event is involved); the resolver records `held` (true/false) on each result. `rate` shown by `node scripts/refdata/slip.mjs` = (prior_rate × prior_n + own slips) / (prior_n + own cases), so our own record gradually replaces the prior. prior_n is deliberately small for classes whose prior is an estimate, so the record takes over quickly.

classes.description: Czech Chamber: agenda item with a fixed date or slot (pevně zařazený bod), expected to be dealt with on that day
classes.source: psp.cz open data, 9th term: 381 of 565 fixed-slot items dealt with at their meeting (67%); pipeline/reference-data/cz-chamber.json, agenda_items.all_items_with_fixed_slot. Measured per meeting, so the slip for one specific day is at least this high.

classes.description: Czech Chamber: a government bill reading expected on a given day without a fixed slot
classes.source: psp.cz open data: government bills dealt with at the meeting where listed — first reading 38% (9th) / 21% (10th), second 70% / 47%, third 36% / 19%; cz-chamber.json agenda_items.

classes.description: Czech Chamber: any other agenda item expected on a given day (opposition or MPs' bills, reports, other points)
classes.source: psp.cz open data: 23% of all agenda items dealt with at their meeting (9th and 10th term); cz-chamber.json agenda_items.all_items.

classes.description: Czech Chamber: state budget reading on its announced day
classes.source: psp.cz open data: every state budget reading listed in the 9th and 10th terms was dealt with at its meeting (15 of 15); day-level obstruction risk estimated.

classes.description: Czech Senate: item on the published agenda of a plenary session
classes.source: Estimate pending our own record; the Senate rarely rolls items over.

classes.description: Czech government: material on the published agenda of a cabinet meeting is approved that day
classes.source: Estimate pending our own record; items are often withdrawn or deferred (vlada.cz programme vs. resolutions).

classes.description: Czech court (ÚS, NSS, high courts): ruling announced for a given day is delivered that day
classes.source: Estimate pending our own record; adjournments are common in national courts.

classes.description: European Parliament: vote on the final draft agenda of a plenary session takes place on the scheduled day
classes.source: Estimate pending our own record; postponements and referrals back to committee are uncommon once on the final draft agenda.

classes.description: Council of the EU: item listed for adoption or political agreement at a scheduled Council meeting is adopted or agreed that day
classes.source: Estimate pending our own record; contested files are often taken off the agenda at Coreper.

classes.description: A trilogue announced as the final one ends with a provisional agreement that day or night
classes.source: Estimate pending our own record; 'final' trilogues frequently need another round.

classes.description: European Commission: proposal listed on the College agenda or the indicative list is adopted on that day
classes.source: Estimate pending our own record; items slip between College meetings fairly often.

classes.description: Court of Justice or General Court: judgment or opinion listed in the judicial calendar is delivered that day
classes.source: The judicial calendar is published in advance and changes rarely; estimate pending our own record.

classes.description: Official statistics release (ČSÚ, Eurostat, national offices) on its calendar date
classes.source: Release calendars are binding; slips are exceptional (system failures, government shutdowns).

classes.description: Central-bank rate decision announced at its scheduled meeting
classes.source: Scheduled monetary-policy meetings are practically never moved; the uncertainty is the decision itself.

classes.description: National or regional election or referendum held on the scheduled day
classes.source: Postponements are rare outside wars and emergencies.

classes.description: Summit, state visit or official meeting of leaders takes place as announced
classes.source: Estimate pending our own record; higher for visits announced only by one side or by media.

classes.description: Negotiating round, talks or envoy meeting reported for a given day takes place that day
classes.source: Estimate pending our own record; reported (not official) talks slip often.

classes.description: UN Security Council meeting or vote on its programme of work takes place on the day
classes.source: Estimate pending our own record; votes are often postponed while drafts are negotiated.

classes.description: Space launch on its scheduled day (within the launch window)
classes.source: Estimate pending our own record; weather and technical scrubs are frequent.

classes.description: Company results, general meeting or announced corporate event on its announced date
classes.source: Financial calendars are rarely changed.

classes.description: Prize announcement, premiere, festival or ceremony on its announced date
classes.source: Estimate pending our own record.

classes.description: Announced strike, demonstration or protest action takes place on the day
classes.source: Estimate pending our own record; strikes are often called off after last-minute deals.

classes.description: Any other scheduled or firmly expected event
classes.source: Generic prior for events without a better class.
